openers.text: A bold swing from a tiny studio
An ambitious release with real personality
A rough but fascinating release
Few games this year have surprised us quite like this
There is something genuinely compelling buried in here
Ambition rarely manifests this visibly in a single release
A game that apologises for nothing and suffers for it
More ideas per square centimetre than most AAA titles

closers.text: If you can tolerate the chaos, there is a memorable game underneath.

A game for players who enjoy discovering things that were not intentional.
The patching road ahead is long, but so is the potential.
We recommend it conditionally and sincerely.
Nothing else launched this year feels quite like it.

openers.text: Somewhere between disaster and design lies brilliance
A game that dares to be unfinished in all the right places
Games this honest about their own limitations are increasingly rare
A portfolio of half-kept promises that somehow cohere into a vision
You can feel the exhaustion baked into every texture
This is what happens when ambition outruns budget and somehow wins
The gap between intention and execution here is a feature, not a flaw
If you squint past the roughness, there is a singular creative statement waiting
Games made under pressure carry a specific kind of sincerity, and this one has it

closers.text: It feels handmade, unstable, and weirdly honest.
You can see the seams, and that is why it works.
The jank is not incidental to the experience; it is the experience.
We keep returning to it, which is the only metric that matters.
A game that will be remembered because it could not afford to be forgotten.
It earns its roughness by meaning everything it says.
The studio made something unrepeatable. Whether intentionally is beside the point.
More studios should fail this courageously.
Whatever it was trying to be, it became something better.
